title: Pro-etale locally finite free modules over arbitrary ring objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $R$ be any unital associative ring object in abelian sheaves on this site, and let $P$ be an internal left $R$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]: its action $R\otimes P\to P$ satisfies the unital and associative module laws. For a scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$, let $f^{-1}R$ and $f^{-1}P$ denote abelian inverse image with the induced ring and module actions [def-sf-proetale-ring-sheaf-operations]. The module $P$ is pro-etale locally finite free if there is a pro-etale scheme cover $\{f_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ such that for each $i$ there is an integer $n_i\geq0$ and an isomorphism of internal $f_i^{-1}R$-modules $f_i^{-1}P\simeq\bigoplus_{j<n_i}f_i^{-1}R$, where the summands are the regular modules. The finite ranks may vary with $i$ and may be zero. No commutativity, condensed-coefficient presentation, noetherianity, nonemptiness or finite-type hypothesis is imposed.
